additional_info.body:
Dear Customer,
Upon reviewing the logs for the reported time, we have observed that the session was not authorized properly, also we identified a communication issue between charger component and EV charger. This disruption in communication caused the charging session to fail.
we have observed that charger is working fine on same day with successful charging session within an hour. We request you kindly asked the customer to try charging once at the same charger with both outlets if required.
Please let me know if there are any further concerns or if you require additional clarification.
With best regards,

Thank you for your patience as I look into your concerns regarding the charging issues with the Vinfast VF8 vehicle.

To further investigate, it is essential that the vehicle is available to charge on any Sicharge D unit, and Siemens must be informed about the session with the date and time within 24 hours. This will help us analyze the situation more effectively.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0385154 - ID0385154-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / P0 312567479/07]  Unable to charge Vinfast VF8 brand Vehicle. CRM:02023000220
additional_info.body:
Dear Sangavie,
I hope this message finds you well.
Regarding your inquiry about the performance timeout and V2G message, I would like to provide some insights. A performance timeout typically occurs when a system or process takes longer than expected to complete a task, which can lead to a timeout error. This is a common occurrence in computing and networking environments, where operations are expected to finish within a certain timeframe.
As for the V2G (Vehicle-to-Grid) message, it is a protocol that facilitates communication between the electric vehicle and the charger. This communication is essential for the charging process to function correctly.
Additionally, I have not heard about the problem with Vinfast VF8 Vehicles until this ticket.
I hope we have answered all your queries, if you're comfortable with it, shall we proceed to bring this case to a close?
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
